The '''Attack on Point Modie''' was a test conducted by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Bella (Twi'lek)|Bella]] to establish the efficiency of the [[Trihexalon|Hex]] Weapons against the [[Mere]] living on [[Point Modie]].

==Prelude==
In preparing for the galactic crisis which was to come, Count [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] set about finding allies for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. He found a like-minded individual in the pirate [[Cavik Toth]], the scourge of the Outer Rim. In return for giving the pirate resources, Toth would develop new weapons. Toth wasted no time in requiring dangerous and illegal [[Trihexalon]] weapons. As the [[Revenant (Mere)|Revenants]] were currently raging a war against [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] occupation, the planet [[Mere]] would be chosen as the testing point for the Hex weapons.

==The battle==
On the orders of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Cavik Toth]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Bella (Twi'lek)|Bella]] assembled five [[Hex Deployer]]s and began an orbital bombardment upon [[Point Modie]]. Having just destroyed a [[Trade Federation Sensor Station]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] sensed a disturbance in [[The Force/Legends|The Force]] and convinced [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] that she should investigated accompanied by Reti. Upon their arrival they found Point Modie in a state of emergency: the city was being bombed by orbit-to-surface Hex missiles, and the population was scrambling to evacuate. Master Gallia and Reti engaged the missiles at once and managed to neutralize a substantial amount, even more so when [[Sol Sixxa]] joined the battle.

After their initial failure the [[Hex Bomber]]s descended and resumed their attacks only now accompanied by [[Sabaoth Squadron/Legends|Sabaoth Squadron]]. Again Gallia, Reti and Sol Sixxa were able to defend the spaceport. When Reti tapped into the enemy's [[Comm unit/Legends|comm]] channel the trio were able to identify [[Bella (Twi'lek)|Bella]]. With the destruction of the last of the Hex bombers Gallia contacted [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] to inform him and the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Council]] that the threat behind the Hex Weapons was [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Cavik Toth]].

==Aftermath==
After discovering that the person behind the attack was Cavik Toth, the [[Mere Resistance]] vowed to stop his reign of terror. They would go on to attack the Hex production plants and eventually face Toth himself in a showdown.

==Behind the scenes==
This particular mission, "Poisoned Skies," was used for the demo of the video game ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter]]''.
